title: Script call-record resizing
summary: Recover 0x4f4f50: reallocate 24-byte call records, preserve current index and update capacity and last-record address with original 32-bit arithmetic and post-helper reloads.
test_description: 252 differential cases call the original resize and accepted realloc with a controlled allocator. Counts include zero, ordinary values, 20000, maximum accepted nonwrapped count and UINT_MAX; offsets include aligned, misaligned, negative and signed extremes. Check EAX, full state and global bytes, allocation arguments, accounting, null returns, and allocator mutation of current.
known_limits: Oversized request branch is transcribed from instructions but not executed: its accepted helper enters unrecovered VM script_error at 0x486ab0.
Allocator failure tests cover null error-frame and null panic normal returns only; longjmp, panic and exception dispatch are not tested.
Explicit 32-bit VM addresses preserve arithmetic; a 64-bit native port needs an address/layout integration layer.
Services adapt custom ECX/EDX helper ABI; no matching-byte claim.
